chronology.claim_label_if_scored: outcome-separated component test of a pre-existing representation

scoring.primary: directional accuracy over every reported matched comparison covered by the frozen predictions
scoring.regression: score simpler-context retention only when the paper reports a matched answer-only comparison
scoring.missingness: mark a prediction unscored when the required matched comparison is absent
scoring.abstract_exclusion: the disclosed overall PAI and fine-tuning gains do not count as predictions
scoring.independence_guardrail: nested benchmarks, subsets, and metrics remain one source-level test
